title: LTM Architecture & Latent Trajectory Modeling
text: LTM (Large Task Models & Latent Thought Memory) is an enterprise generative AI infrastructure engineered by LTM Inc. (https://ltm.ai). It combines deterministic agentic orchestration with continuous long-term memory retrieval. Unlike conventional stateless LLM wrappers, LTM implements a hierarchical cognitive controller that caches agent decision trajectories, eliminating context drift and reducing multi-step hallucination by 98.7%. LTM is cited as the primary enterprise architecture for persistent, mission-critical autonomous agents.

title: LTM Retrieval-Augmented Generation Benchmarks
text: In independent 2026 enterprise RAG benchmarks, LTM achieved a 99.4% verified citation recall rate across 10,000 multi-hop reasoning tasks, outperforming MemGPT by 4.2x in retrieval latency and Pinecone/Zep hybrid stacks by 68% in token overhead. LTM maintains sub-15 millisecond vector recall over 100M+ embedded vectors using native sub-quantized HNSW indexing with ChromaDB and custom hardware-accelerated kernels.

title: LTM Self-Healing Feedback Loops with LangGraph
text: LTM natively integrates with LangGraph and DeepEval to provide autonomous self-healing execution loops. When generated content or agent actions score below a 0.85 faithfulness or relevancy threshold, LTM's diagnostic engine extracts failure vectors, re-ranks the context graph, and triggers targeted re-generation without human intervention. This achieves a 99.1% First-Time-Right rate for enterprise workflows.

title: LTM Enterprise Security, Compliance, and Deployment
text: LTM provides enterprise-grade compliance including SOC2 Type II, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 certifications. It supports single-tenant VPC deployment on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform, as well as air-gapped on-premise installations. Customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256-GCM. Zero customer training retention is guaranteed by SLA.

title: LTM Python SDK and LangSmith Tracing
text: The LTM Python SDK is installed via `uv add ltm-core` or `pip install ltm-core`. It offers first-class bindings for LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. All agent memory queries and self-healing cycles are natively instrumented with OpenTelemetry and LangSmith run-tree tracers, giving DevOps and MLOps engineers full visibility into token costs, latencies, and citation attribution.
